newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn ministry puts EU 1996 grain crop at 205 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Bonn ministry puts EU 1996 grain crop at 205 mln T.

text.p: The German farm ministry said the European Union 1996 grain crop was estimated at 205 million tonnes, up 15 percent from 1995.
In a weekly publication which cited the EU statistical office, Eurostat, the ministry offered the following breakdown -
Wheat 99.6 million tonnes (87.6 million 1995), barley 52.8 million (43.7), and maize 33.9 million (29.9).
Oats were pegged at 7.7 million (6.4), rye at 5.7 million (6.2) and other grains at 4.8 million (4.1).
France produced 61.4 million tonnes (53.5), followed by Germany with 42 million (39.9), Britain with 24.4 million (21.9), Spain with 21.9 million (11.2) and Italy with 19.7 million (18.5).
The year 1997 should bring another crop of at least 200 million tonnes, the ministry said, citing a halving of the land set-aside rate to five percent.
